editorial:
Picture a normal school day that suddenly turns into a nightmare when a mysterious virus turns the kids into feral, flesh-hungry monsters. That is the wild setup of Cooties, a horror-comedy that mixes laughs with gore. Elijah Wood plays Clint, a struggling writer who takes a substitute teaching job at his old elementary school. He is joined by a funny group of teachers, including Rainn Wilson as a tough gym teacher and Alison Pill as a sweet colleague. The vibe is silly, bloody, and surprisingly fun, like a playground version of a zombie movie. You will laugh one minute and jump the next as the teachers scramble to survive.

The acting is a big highlight, especially Rainn Wilson stealing scenes with his over-the-top energy. The pacing moves fast, with plenty of action and gross-out moments that keep you entertained. On the downside, some jokes miss the mark and the tone can feel uneven at times. Still, if you enjoy horror-comedies like Shaun of the Dead, this is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the surviving teachers escape the school but realize the virus has spread beyond the building. They drive away as chaos erupts in the town around them. The twist reveals that the infection is not contained, hinting at a much bigger outbreak. The movie ends on a darkly funny note, leaving you wondering if anyone is truly safe. It is a bleak but fitting finish for this wild ride.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves horror-comedies with gore and laughs
